item.title: Prof. Yuval Elbashan to Arutz Sheva: Prosecution's problems go beyond Netanyahu trial
item.description: Prof. Yuval Elbashan says problems in Netanyahu cases were long clear, warns against proceeding without review, urges AG to weigh a deal and backs judges, "We have a court that does not yield to public pressure from either side".

item.title: IDF reveals: Hamas uses Gaza hospital as interrogation and torture center
item.description: New intelligence released by the IDF and ISA reveals that Hamas has converted infrastructure at Al-Ahli Arab Hospital in northern Gaza into a secured facility where Gazan civilians are interrogated and tortured.

item.title: Defendant bursts into tears; presiding judge turns to PayBox
item.description: A neighbors' dispute at Eretz Hemdah's monetary court ended in a settlement. When the defendant tearfully described her financial hardship, the presiding judge requested her husband's PayBox details and sent the couple NIS 2,000 from a charity fund.
